name: Flatland

sections.text:
X 6000 300 12 -48 10000 0 1500
Flatland (Med Hard)
  Flatland is a grassy prarie planet.  
The targets are spread across the 
ground with a minimum of force 
fields.  If you like flying against 
AAA and KLA's, try this theater.
  Warning: On this planet the air is
a very thin dense layer.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------------- Welcome to Henderson Field -------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Pandora's Box
 Direction         : South South East
 Distance          : 20  miles
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth -7293012 -3685851 67261 32767
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Here is a mission which really should be for the ground forces, but
this time it's up to us.  There is a site 20 miles south of here which
has an orb that is very well defended with force fields.  Your 
secondary mission is to take out the saucer site on the roof, but the
primary objective is the generator orb that is lying on its side inside
the protective shields.
  The force fields are so effectively placed that the orb is 
inaccessible from the air.  Set your plane down very gently on the 
grass, and then taxi over to the parking lot.  Take an assassin bomb 
into the fortress, and place it in the middle of the fallen orb.  It 
may take more than one bomb, so be prepared to get back to your plane 
for more bombs.
------------------------------------------------------------------------






 Mission Code Name : French Poodle
 Direction         : South East
 Distance          : 15  miles
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth -6039192 -6170846 164000 34340
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  There's a nasty little gathering of AAA, Mortars, and KLA's to the
Southeast of here.  Go take it all out.
------------------------------------------------------------------------





 Mission Code Name : Garden Patch
 Direction         : North East
 Distance          : 21  miles
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth -3630388 -5463117 187295 57002
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  There's a small fuel facility located Northeast of here.  It is 
protected by passive defense and KLA's only.  Even though there are no
AAA to deal with, getting at these buggers may prove to be difficult.
  Don't bother trying to take out the blue flashing based orb, it is a
new type which is almost indestructible.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------ Welcome to Dulles International Airport -------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Cerebral Dynamite
 Direction         : North West
 Distance          : 20  miles
 Difficulty        : 2
Sxyth 793176 -2925141 83414 6952
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The enemy has set up a mindbender unit to the Northwest of this
airstrip.  Although the installation of an MB unit is always a threat,
in this case it is a real emergency.
  Our intelligence has uncovered an alien scheme to modify a mindbender
to instantly drive all humans within a 50 mile radius completely insane.
At this moment, the top brass along with the evil alien scientists are
celebrating the activation of the unit by partaking in a mind-altering
ceremony.  Your mission is to sneak upon them, and blow up the MB unit,
as well as neutralizing all the aliens.  This may be enough to kill the
project permanently.
  The mindbender is operating normally at the moment, so be prepared to
face some effects from the MB unit as usual.
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : War of the Worlds
 Direction         : North East
 Distance          : 23  miles
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth 1425828 -7314141 65932 3262
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  There are 4 saucer sites more than 20 miles North East of here.  One
site is about 14 miles distant, and then there are two more farther
Northeast.  Take out these sites, and also any saucers which are left
in the air.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------- Welcome to Bubba's Airstrip -----------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Free For All
 Direction         : North North East
 Distance          : 5  miles
 Difficulty        : 4
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  To the north is a very spread out mishmash of enemy forces.  Your 
mission is to destroy dumps, mindbenders, and or anything else you care
to blow up.  There is some difficult stuff out there, but enough mission
objectives to really get a decent score.
  Start out at your airstrip, and fly due north to engage.
------------------------------------------------------------------------







 Mission Code Name : Corncob
 Direction         : West North West
 Distance          : 20  miles
 Difficulty        : 2
Sxyth 2887095 -6705381 190000 0
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The largest fuel facility to date is laid out to the North West of
here, with only KLA's for defense.  Blow up the fuel depot, and detonate
the generator orb as a secondary objective.  The orbs are all disguised
with light distorters, so it's up to you to sort things out when you
get there.
  The layout of this storage area is a bit odd...
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------------ Welcome to the Weedsport Airport --------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Available Missions:

 Mission Code Name : Country Club
 Direction         : South South West
 Distance          : 12  miles
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth -6032118 115221 83065 30070
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  We have learned of a secret meeting of alien commanders from all over
this theater.  Among them are going to be some of the monsters 
responsible for the incineration of Kansas City and Montreal.  We need
a gutsy pilot to land his plane, and proceed on foot to kill all
aliens with his handgun. 
  Choose a protected location to park your plane, or you may be walking
home.
------------------------------------------------------------------------





 Mission Code Name : Swiss Cheese
 Direction         : North East
 Distance          : 7  miles
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth -4395774 -253238 91160 0
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  We don't know what their hiding up to the North East, but whatever
it is, it must be good.  There are more than 5 top notch AAA sites 
guarding a lonely orb.  Take out the orb any which way you can.
------------------------------------------------------------------------







 Mission Code Name : Eye in the Keyhole
 Direction         : East
 Distance          : 7  miles
 Difficulty        : 2
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The aliens have setup a generator orb under a blanket of forcefields.
The problem is that they left a little hole in the center to breathe
through.  Take out the orb, but don't let the enemy KLA's blow you
a new orifice.
  Take off from your airstrip and head due east, you can't miss it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------- Welcome to RDU ^international Airport ----------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Stacked Deck
 Direction         : North West
 Distance          : 12  miles
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth -95704 929236 190000 9740
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Three saucers of varying quality are parked in a vertical stack to
the Northwest of here.  Your mission object is to blow the orb and its
stack to kingdom come.
------------------------------------------------------------------------







 Mission Code Name : Field 'o Flak
 Direction         : North North East
 Distance          : 15  miles
 Difficulty        : 4
Sxyth 459973 -600857 190000 0
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  There is concentration to the north which is a heavy concentration
of enemy AAA.  Fuel dumps are disguised as small purple spheres.  Your
mission is to destroy the orb and the fuel dumps.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------ Welcome to Sweetly Bending Oak Aircraft Park --------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


Available Missions:


 Mission Code Name : Learner's Permit
 Direction         : South East
 Distance          : 8  miles
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth -6305029 3117870 76239 40834
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  A saucer is parked on the ground amidst an outpost 8 mi south east.
There is AAA protecting the site, and some ground transports milling
around.  Try to cause as much damage to the saucer before it panics
and takes off.  They have the aircraft hemmed in so tightly that there
is a good chance of it hitting their own force fields while trying to
escape.
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Chocolate Sprinkles
 Direction         : West
 Distance          : 7 miles
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth -5138904 4825923 113096 20100
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  To the west is a very spread out fuel storage facility.  It is poorly
defended with AAA and KLA sites.  Your orders are to take out all the
fuel storage spheres.
------------------------------------------------------------------------





 Mission Code Name : Saucer Simplicity
 Direction         : North North East
 Distance          : 7 miles
 Difficulty        : 2
Sxyth -4133871 3784953 35303 0
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The is an undefended lone saucer site to the north of here.  Take out
the orb and the saucer site there.  Also take out any saucers which 
launch from the site.
------------------------------------------------------------------------






 Mission Code Name : Desperate Hammerblow
 Direction         : North West
 Distance          : 7 miles
 Difficulty        : 5
Sxyth -3749685 4118226 190000 15760
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  There is a refinery for the new alien superfuel used only in the top
of the line KLA sites near here.  The defenses are formidable AAA and 
KLA.  These defenses are so tough that it may be impossible to limp
home after receiving the damage that will be dished out to you.
  However, intelligence reports that there are several portals near the
generator orb, and at least one of these portals will pop you back over
this airfield.  Your mission is to take out the fuel dumps, and then
escape the enemy fire via the portal.  Be ready to bail in case your
plane becomes to damaged to fly.
------------------------------------------------------------------------





 Mission Code Name : Timothy O'Leary
 Direction         : North East
 Distance          : 15 miles
 Difficulty        : 5
Sxyth -2845381 3086332 106085 53448
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The medical staff in the surrounding airfields are reporting an
anomalously high number of cases of nausea.  We believe the aliens to 
be using some kind of machine which interferes with our minds.  The
center of the effect lies at a site northeast of here.
  Your mission is to find the cause of the disturbance, and if possible
neutralize it with an assassin bomb.  They have built their gathering
near an abandon airstrip.  Land your plane and do the search on foot.
This outpost is protected by high-q AAA, and there also appears to be 
a saucer site on the premises.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

               Nearby airstrips with more missions

------------------------------------------------------------------------
North: Easter Island Municipal Air Travel Center
East:  Weedsport Airport
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------- Welcome to Easter Island Municipal Air Travel Center ----------
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : Cubic Lattice
 Direction         : West
 Distance          : 11 miles
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth -242237 5751298 55355 17234
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Here is yet another fuel storage facility.  Here there are no obvious
active defense system, although in past attacks there have been systems
triggered by air attack, so keep vigilant.  Take out all the fuel 
spheres.
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Mission Code Name : May Pole
 Direction         : East South East
 Distance          : 6 miles
 Difficulty        : 3
Sxyth -888815 3173965 128071 36278
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  An increase in enemy ground transport operations has prompted us to
finally attack the vehicle sites to the west of here.  There is  AAA
and KLA defense.  The curious mounting of the AAA sites is no doubt an
experiment.
  Your mission objective is to destroy all ground vehicles and their
sites.  You may blast the orb for dessert if you like.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------- Valmart Airstrip and Family Value Center ----------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Mission Code Name : Ant Hill
 Direction         : North West
 Distance          : 3 miles
 Difficulty        : 2
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  There is a large number of ground transports in our immediate
vicinity.  Though these are mostly just a nuisance, the problem has
increased steadily until something must be done soon.
  Take out all vehicles and vehicle sites near the orb North West of 
here.  Beware of deathballs.
  Take off right from your airstrip, and head north west.  You can't 
miss this large gathering of enemy forces.
------------------------------------------------------------------------





 Mission Code Name : Newton's Mistake
 Direction         : North East
 Distance          : 13 miles
 Difficulty        : 2
Sxyth 4924375 2960548 90060 57870
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The aliens are just starting a new construction project to the
North East of here.  Go in there and trash their orbs, but be careful.
The scientists are getting some strange readings from that area.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
